MalGanisNecroticEmbraceWingedGuard.name: Winged Guard
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceWingedGuard.description: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack. If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 6 seconds.

MalGanisVampiricTouchVampiricAura.name: Vampiric Aura
MalGanisVampiricTouchVampiricAura.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 30% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 15% of Physical Damage dealt.

MalGanisVampiricTouchTimeToFeed.name: Time to Feed
MalGanisVampiricTouchTimeToFeed.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 (+4% per level) when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceFueledByTorment.name: Fueled by Torment
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceFueledByTorment.description: While Necrotic Embrace is active, Mal'Ganis heals for 12 (+4% per level) when damage is taken and Vampiric Touch converts 20% more Hero damage into healing.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceMightOfSargeras.name: Might of Sargeras
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceMightOfSargeras.description: Necrotic Embrace's Armor is increased to 50.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceEchoOfDoom.name: Echo of Doom
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceEchoOfDoom.description: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 (+4% per level) damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

MalGanisFelClawsBlackClaws.name: Black Claws
MalGanisFelClawsBlackClaws.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

MalGanisFelClawsWillOfTichondrius.name: Will of Tichondrius
MalGanisFelClawsWillOfTichondrius.description: Each enemy Hero hit by the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws causes the final slash to steal 1% of maximum Health from enemy Heroes, up to 4%. If at least 4 enemy Heroes are hit with the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws, then the final slash Stuns enemies for an additional 0.5 seconds.

MalGanisNightRushSpreadingPlague.name: Spreading Plague
MalGanisNightRushSpreadingPlague.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

MalGanisCarrionSwarm.name: Carrion Swarm
MalGanisCarrionSwarm.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies. Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

MalGanisDarkConversion.name: Dark Conversion
MalGanisDarkConversion.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

MalGanisNightRushDeepSleep.name: Deep Sleep
MalGanisNightRushDeepSleep.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 10%.

MalGanisNightRushTheNightBeckons.name: The Night Beckons
MalGanisNightRushTheNightBeckons.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

MalGanisVampiricTouchBloodRush.name: Blood Rush
MalGanisVampiricTouchBloodRush.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

MalGanisNecroticEmbracePlagueBats.name: Plague Bats
MalGanisNecroticEmbracePlagueBats.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 (+4% per level) damage.

MalGanisVampiricTouchFrenziedAssault.name: Frenzied Assault
MalGanisVampiricTouchFrenziedAssault.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt. Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

MalGanisFelClawsBlindAsABat.name: Blind as a Bat
MalGanisFelClawsBlindAsABat.description: Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 6 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.

MalGanisCarrionSwarmSeekerSwarm.name: Seeker Swarm
MalGanisCarrionSwarmSeekerSwarm.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

MalGanisDarkConversionWrathOfNathreza.name: Wrath of Nathreza
MalGanisDarkConversionWrathOfNathreza.description: Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 75% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds. Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

MalGanisFelClawsVanquishTheWeak.name: Vanquish the Weak
MalGanisFelClawsVanquishTheWeak.description: Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.

MalGanisNightRushAloneInTheDark.name: Alone in the Dark
MalGanisNightRushAloneInTheDark.description: Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.
